_note: Dials for scripts/ics.mjs (industrial control system and OT advisories, no AI model). The sources themselves are in the script (SOURCES), with the hosts each may be fetched from. window_days: advisories first published within this many days are kept in data/ics/advisories.json. max_fetch_per_source: CSAF documents read per source per run (the newest first; the rest are read on later runs). Leads: an advisory first published within lead_days becomes a lead for the research loop (kind advisory) when it is known exploited or exploited per the advisory, has a CVSS base score of at least lead_cvss, or has at least sector_cvss in one of lifeline_sectors (CISA's critical infrastructure sector names); at most max_leads_per_run per run, each advisory once.
